status: PROPOSAL - OPTIONAL check (CLI flag --label-value), development data only; false-positive rate and recall on unseen layouts NOT EVALUATED

phrase_gap_em.unit: em (word height); words of one line closer than this form one phrase

same_line_fraction.unit: fraction of the smaller word height; vertical centres closer than this are on the same line

max_value_gap_em.unit: em; a phrase further right of a label than this is not its value

below_max_gap_lines.unit: line heights; a phrase below a label further away than this is not its value

below_left_tolerance_em.unit: em; a value below a label must start within this distance of the label's left edge or under the label

max_label_words.unit: words before the colon of a label

min_label_letters.unit: letters needed in a label (so '08:30' or 'a:' is not a label)

not_a_label_patterns.unit: regular expressions (case-insensitive) tested on the whole phrase; a phrase that matches is not a 'Label:' phrase: (1) the first colon belongs to a URL scheme ('http://...'), (2) an index in square brackets glued to the token before the colon ('Main[3]:Up' port/cell notation; 'Pressure[psi]:' is NOT matched). A-445, set on the A-441 false alarms S005 and S013 (DEV/SEEN, one document family each)

min_pairs_for_page_signal.unit: mismatching pairs on a page needed for the page signal

max_listed_pairs.unit: mismatching pairs copied into the signal evidence
